name: Silent Laughs
description: Pratfalls, pianos and title cards: Chaplin's Keystone, Essanay and Mutual shorts, Buster Keaton in The General, Sherlock Jr. and Steamboat Bill, Jr., Harold Lloyd dangling from the clock in Safety Last!, plus Harry Langdon, Charley Chase, Mabel Normand, Fatty Arbuckle and the Sennett gang. Laurel & Hardy's silent two-reelers play weeknights at 6:00 pm in release order, and the Our Gang kids take over Saturday mornings at 9:00.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 78 hours of hand-listed silent comedy items (1909-1929), picked from the Internet Archive's silent_films and Silent Hall of Fame collections and the 1927-29 Comedy_Films uploads, plus 23 Laurel & Hardy silents (weeknight slot) and 11 Our Gang silents (Saturday slot). Excluded: colorized prints, modern compilations and documentaries, talkies, incomplete or mislabeled copies (several silent-* Keaton uploads were fragments, swapped for complete prints), Blu-ray box-set items whose file names left junk in titles, and racially caricatured shorts (Haunted Spooks, Spook Spoofing, Uncle Tom's Uncle, Shootin' Injuns).
